provenance.source: wx2 (legacy MSSQL, database wx2), 只读 SELECT
provenance.stock_scope: 本地 PG members_at(as_of=2026-11-24, dt=2024-05-15, universe_id='all_a')
provenance.value_format: wx2 numeric 的十进制字符串，原样保存（moneyflowh 与 actlargemedcut 为 numeric(10,6)，abso_umr 为 numeric(20,8)）

abso_umr.sql: SELECT stock_code, abso_umr FROM dbo.stock_abso_umr WHERE trade_date = %s

moneyflowh.sql: SELECT stock_code, moneyflowh FROM dbo.stock_moneyflowh WHERE trade_date = %s

actlargemedcut.sql: SELECT stock_code, actlargemedcut FROM dbo.stock_actlargemedcut WHERE trade_date = %s
